summary.en: Professor Agasa takes Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys to the house of a famous aquarium designer, Nishida. Kosuke Imura lets them into Nishida's home when Nishida does not answer the door. The Detective Boys find Nishida drowned in his bathtub. Location: Nishida's house Victim: Satoshi Nishida Cause of death: Drowning Suspects: Kosuke Imura Nishida is found drowned in the bathtub. The police determine that Nishida died the night two days prior and from falling asleep in his bathtub due to alcohol consumption. Conan disproves the theory explaining that the bathroom light was not on when they found him. The police investigate Imura's alibi which confirmed he was in Guam for the past two days at a shooting range.
